baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional إن أصبح ماؤكم غورا is answered by فمن يأتيكم بماء معين.
baseline_models.mechanism: Possessed water changes into water recessed below access; reversing that loss requires both delivery and a reopened flowing source, not merely the abstract existence of water.

activation_trace.role: Becoming supplies the abrupt transition from an available resource to a new inaccessible state.
Ordinary water is the same substance on both sides of the conditional; accessibility, not identity, changes.
Descent into depth removes the water from the usable surface.
A watercourse and the opening of its route make bringing water a hydraulic operation.
The flowing, exposed spring is the functional opposite of water sunk beyond reach.

changed_reading.before: A generic warning that water could disappear.
changed_reading.after: A hydraulic-access test: who can reverse vertical loss, reopen a route, and restore water as an actively available spring?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أرأيتم opens a visual-intellectual demand, while غورا and معينا oppose disappearance to an eye-visible spring.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question asks the hearers to inspect a failure of inspection: their water can pass below sight, and the desired replacement is named through a root that joins spring, eyewitnessing, and visible presence.

activation_trace.role: The أرأيتم construction demands attention and a report rather than passive seeing.
Eye and insight make perceptibility part of the test.
Depth hides the resource while leaving its possible subsurface existence intact.
Eyewitness presence sharpens معين as water available in manifest experience.
The visible flowing source resolves the verse's hidden-versus-seen axis materially.

changed_reading.before: Have you considered what would happen if the water were gone?
changed_reading.after: Look at the limit of looking itself: the sustaining resource can withdraw below every eye, and only a newly manifest spring would answer the loss.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أصبح can mark both becoming and the arrival of morning beside two mentions of water.
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammatical change of state retains a live dawn image: an ordinary household awakens and discovers failure before its first morning drink, compressing catastrophe into one daily threshold.

activation_trace.role: First light supplies the temporal edge at which the loss is discovered.
The morning drink makes water deprivation bodily and routine rather than remote.
Becoming preserves the primary state-change mechanism beneath the temporal image.
Literal water is the daily necessity whose absence is immediately testable.

changed_reading.before: A timeless hypothetical change in the water supply.
changed_reading.after: An overnight reversal discovered at dawn, when habitual possession meets the first unmet need for a drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening's blessing and dominion acquire a material closing test: retained water is both a settled good and the mainstay on which an ordered domain stands.

activation_trace.role: Fixed water in a basin turns blessing into a retained, inhabitable stock rather than an abstraction.
Water as the mainstay of the matter makes control of water the material proof of dominion.
The focus names the concrete substance through which the opening claim is tested.
The resource ceases to support the domain when it drops below practical reach.

structural_cues: The surah opens with dominion in 67:1 and closes by testing control over the resource on which settlement depends.
The possessive ماؤكم is answered by an agent question, separating human possession from actual control.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retained basin-water and water as the mainstay of an affair; I infer an opening-to-closing frame in which dominion is demonstrated through hydrological maintenance. The live alternative is that water is only one representative object under universal power.

changed_reading.before: Water loss is one arbitrary example of divine power.
changed_reading.after: The final question materializes dominion at its load-bearing point: apparent ownership fails when no one else can keep the domain's main resource available.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier question about a provider if provision is withheld is replayed as a concrete water ablation: rain-fed sustenance is held back, then the closing verse asks who can restore its accessible form.

activation_trace.role: Provision as bodily sustenance establishes the dependency that water loss immediately exposes.
Rain descending as provision connects the general رزق question directly to the water cycle.
Holding and withholding supplies the upstream interruption of provision.
A place that retains water makes withholding a storage failure as well as a refusal.
Bringing or giving water is the demanded reversal of withheld provision.
A running source is provision restored in a continuously usable form.

structural_cues: 67:21 and 67:30 both use a conditional resource failure followed by a question about an alternative provider.
The second-person plural beneficiaries recur in يرزقكم, رزقه, ماؤكم, and يأتيكم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sustenance, rain-as-provision, withholding, and water-retaining capacity; I infer that 67:30 is the concrete terminal case of 67:21's general ablation. The live alternative is that the two questions are parallel but independent examples.

changed_reading.before: The final verse introduces a new drought hypothetical.
changed_reading.after: The final verse performs the earlier provision test on the resource that cannot be substituted: withhold its storage and flow, then ask the claimed provider to restore it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context constructs a vertical habitat: earth can swallow downward, birds remain above only while held, and water can likewise sink below reach. Life occupies the maintained interval between those failures.

activation_trace.role: The earth's subsidence establishes downward engulfment as an active threat.
The explicit recession of a well and its water anticipates the focus condition with unusual precision.
The birds occupy the upper pole of the vertical system.
Active holding prevents the upper creature from falling out of its life-supporting layer.
Water leaving downward supplies the lower and opposite failure of retention.
The spring returns water to the surface layer where embodied life can meet it.

structural_cues: 67:16 threatens engulfment by the earth, 67:19 displays creatures maintained above, and 67:30 removes water beneath.
The focus opposition is not existence versus nonexistence but below-reach versus surface flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite vertical motions and an exact branch for a well's receding water; I infer a maintained habitable band between sky and depth. The alternative is to read each vertical image locally without a shared system.

changed_reading.before: The water table happens to drop.
changed_reading.after: The same sustaining governance that keeps flight from falling also keeps water from escaping beneath life; the question tests the stability of the whole vertical habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated inspection, reverence toward what is unseen, and the opposition of hidden to overt speech activate the focus as a controlled passage from seeing, through disappearance, to a spring made manifest.

activation_trace.role: Repeated visual inspection establishes seeing as an evidentiary practice across the surah.
Concealment from eyes makes invisibility a spiritually charged condition rather than mere absence.
A depression in which something disappears gives the unseen axis a spatial mechanism that fits recessed water.
Open appearance to the eye supplies the opposite pole to hiddenness.
Making well water appear by cleaning it turns manifestation into a concrete access operation.
The final أرأيتم explicitly summons the established inspection practice.
The exposed spring is the desired conversion of hidden subsurface water into visible availability.

structural_cues: Commands and questions of seeing recur at 67:3, 67:4, 67:19, 67:27, 67:28, and 67:30.
The focus begins with أرأيتم but makes the object inaccessible to sight before ending on معين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated seeing, concealment in a depression, overt visibility, and the revealing of well water; I infer that the final hydrology also stages an epistemic limit. The alternative is that أرأيتم is only an idiom for considering and carries no visual residue.

changed_reading.before: The audience is simply told to think about missing water.
changed_reading.after: The audience must use sight to discover sight's dependence: a hidden source cannot be inspected into availability, while a manifest spring would itself be evidence of restored care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rain gives earth life, becomes edible provision, revives dry pasture, and distinguishes inhabitable land from rainless waste. The focus therefore removes the input to an ecological chain, not only a person's drink.

activation_trace.role: Earth's life through rain and vegetation defines water as an animator of habitat.
Rain as provision links water to the command to eat from what the earth yields.
Rain reviving dry pasture supplies the regenerative step of the ecological chain.
Land without rain gives the terminal state produced when water no longer returns.
The focus removes and then demands the substance that drives every linked stage.

structural_cues: 67:15 joins a tractable earth, walking, eating, provision, and return to life in one sequence.
The final possessive plural broadens the loss from an individual drink to a community's water system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-animated earth, food provision, revived pasture, and rainless land; I supply the causal arrow water to vegetation to food to settlement. The live alternative is the narrower and immediate physiology of thirst.

changed_reading.before: The threat concerns a population losing drinking water.
changed_reading.after: The focus switches off the habitat's regenerative input: no surface source means no revived ground, food cycle, or durable settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tractable earth lets things run on their course, walkers require a viable path, and livelihood requires a supporting structure. These cues activate يأتيكم as the routing of water through earth back to users.

activation_trace.role: A thing running along its prepared course makes earth's tractability hydraulic as well as pedestrian.
Movement requires a traversable relation between source, route, and destination.
The straight path supplies the context's explicit image of unobstructed routing.
Mainstay and livelihood name what a functioning route ultimately supports.
The watercourse branch anchors the analogy in the focus verb of bringing.
Depth is the route failure that must be overcome.

structural_cues: 67:15 and 67:22 repeatedly place movement on or through the earth before 67:30 asks how water will reach the audience.
The focus contrasts a terminal depth with arrival إلى the beneficiaries.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tractable flow, walking, a straight path, livelihood, and a focus watercourse; I infer that guidance imagery lends its route mechanics to hydrology. The live alternative is that the path remains solely moral and the overlap is analogical only.

changed_reading.before: An alternative agent would somehow produce replacement water.
changed_reading.after: An alternative agent would have to make a viable path through resistant depth and conduct water all the way back into communal use.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questions about an army's help and a protector's shelter culminate in reliance on the one sufficient caretaker; the final فمن then audits substitution at the level of resource service rather than argument.

activation_trace.role: Rain as rescuing aid fuses support with hydrological relief.
The water-support image makes the proposed helper answerable for an actual supply structure.
Protection within another's guarantee supplies the failed shelter model immediately before the focus.
The one who sufficiently manages an affair supplies the positive caretaker role against rival substitutes.
Actual delivery is the service by which every claimed protector or caretaker is tested.

structural_cues: The sequence asks who can help in 67:20, provide in 67:21, protect in 67:28, and bring water in 67:30.
67:29's declaration of reliance stands directly between the protection and water questions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-like aid, protected proximity, sufficient caretaking, and delivery; I infer that the repeated interrogatives test a single substitute-agent system. The live alternative is that each question rebuts a separate claim without cumulative force.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks who could solve a private drought emergency.
changed_reading.after: The verse is the final service-level test of every rival protector: can the claimed caretaker actually deliver the resource on which all protection depends?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ر و ي target of the focus root ر ء ي, not the grammatical sense of أرأيتم. It remains anchored because hydration, drawing water, deliberation, literal water, and a spring all occur inside the focus inventory and wording. Downstream prose should call it a form-distant branch resonance, never a translation or asserted wordplay.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root under أرأيتم maps not only to seeing but also to ر و ي beside ماؤكم and ماء معين.

activation_trace.role: Quenching thirst shadows the requested act of considering with the bodily result at stake.
Drawing and carrying water turns reflection into a logistics trace from source to household.
Deliberation keeps the remote mapping attached to the actual interrogative posture.
Literal water prevents the remote activation from becoming an independent theme.
The spring provides the terminal source toward which the hydration logistics run.

changed_reading.before: أرأيتم only introduces a thought experiment about water.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the thought verb carries the whole bodily and logistical circuit it asks the audience to imagine: thirst, fetching, and replenishment from a source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 67:28 uses عذاب in its ordinary punitive setting, while the cited inventory also opens sweetness of water, abstention from drink, and withholding. It remains valid as an adjacency activation into 67:30's literal water loss. Downstream prose should preserve punishment as the contextual sense and present deprivation of sweet water only as a material rendering of that threat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The water-loss conditional immediately follows a verse ending in عذاب أليم and remains anchored in ماؤكم غورا and ماء معين.

activation_trace.role: Sweet, pleasant water identifies the positive good whose removal the focus stages.
The body's abstention from food and drink supplies the physiological form of deprivation.
Withholding converts punishment from an added blow into removal of a necessity.
Literal water is the necessity withdrawn and requested again.
The flowing spring is the sweet accessible good against which deprivation is measured.

changed_reading.before: Painful punishment and the subsequent water hypothetical are separate threats.
changed_reading.after: The final hypothetical gives punishment a material form: the body and settlement are hurt by being withheld from the sweet water that normally sustains them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant mapped-root activation: both ع ت د and و ع د expose root_000989's الماء العد branch, although their contextual senses are preparation and promise. It remains anchored because the focus culminates in flowing spring water. Downstream prose should describe a recurrent branch counter-image, not derive either context word from the water term or claim an intended etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus asks for ماء معين after context roots for what is prepared and promised both expose an inventory image of perennial water.

activation_trace.role: Perennial water supplies an unexpected resource image beneath what has been prepared.
The same perennial-water image recurs beneath the demanded promise and gives the remote activation sequence support.
The final literal water anchors both remote context activations.
A running spring supplies the durable-water endpoint of the counter-image.

changed_reading.before: The prepared punishment, the disputed promise, and the final water question occupy unrelated semantic fields.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, what is prepared and awaited is counter-imaged by the truly continuous provision at stake: perennial water that no rival can guarantee.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the earlier question root س ء ل reaches a non-dominant س ل ل inventory of smooth flow and a valley channel, while the focus uses a different interrogative construction. It remains anchored in فمن يأتيكم and the focus watercourse and spring branches. Downstream prose should call it a cross-question activation, not assign the channel sense to سأل in 67:8.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The earlier question هل جاءكم نذير activates flow imagery that the final question فمن يأتيكم بماء معين can materially resolve.

activation_trace.role: Smooth flowing supplies a remote process image beneath the act of questioning.
A channel in a valley gives the remote flow image a spatial route.
The focus verb's watercourse branch makes channeling part of the actual question.
The flowing spring is the route's demanded output.

changed_reading.before: The earlier warning question and the final provider question share only rhetoric.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sequence of questions becomes conduit-like: warning asks whether guidance arrived, and the last question asks whether life-giving flow can arrive through any channel at all.

strongest_changes: The opening claim of dominion becomes material at the close because water is activated as the mainstay of an ordered, settled domain.
67:30 concretely repeats 67:21's withheld-provision test, turning general رزق into retained rain, stored water, and restored flow.
Earth-swallowing and birds held above frame accessible water as part of a maintained vertical habitat.
The surah's seeing and hiddenness sequence makes غورا to معينا an epistemic as well as hydraulic reversal.
Rain-life, food, revived pasture, and rainless land enlarge the threat from thirst to ecological uninhabitability.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses speech, inspection, sudden state change, possession, downward recession, delivery, and visible spring-flow into one unanswerable infrastructure question. Context changes it from a generic drought warning into a final audit of dominion, provision, protection, and the maintained surface on which life depends.
remaining_uncertainties: The temporal morning image in أصبح is live but may be secondary to the ordinary state-change function.
The exact degree of visual force retained in أرأيتم, beyond its attention and report idiom, remains open.
Non-dominant mappings such as ر و ي, ع د د, and س ل ل are diagnostically productive but should remain explicitly exploratory in downstream prose.
The punishment-to-water-deprivation activation may be adjacency-driven rather than part of the strongest contextual mechanism.
